items.description: Analyze repository structure and module wiring
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce a module map covering `.archivara/concept_evolve.py`, `.archivara/semantic_scholar.py`, `results/literature/`, `results/swarm/`, and `results/verification/`; for each, list inputs, outputs, generated artifacts, and dependencies on other modules.
items.notes: Created `results/analysis/module_map.md`; repaired the stale `evolve -> _run_sub_agent()` call in `.archivara/concept_evolve.py`; ran the mandatory ConceptEvolve pass, which produced `results/concept_evolve/concept_cards.json`, `semantic_bridge.json`, `introspection.json`, `steering_directions.json`, and concept tree folders.

items.description: Read and reconcile persistent context plus director swarm guidance before choosing a branch
items.acceptance_criteria: Read `results/research_context.md`, `results/literature/prior_art_watchlist.md`, `results/literature/novelty_guard.json`, `results/literature/gap_frontier.md`, `results/swarm/director_brief.md`, `results/swarm/hypotheses.json`, and `results/swarm/tool_plan.md`; write a one-page brief naming H1 as champion, H2 as backup, H3 as reserve or explicitly justifying a change, with branch kill rules copied from the swarm.
items.notes: Wrote `results/analysis/branch_brief.md`, retaining H1 as champion, H2 as backup, and H3 as reserve while explicitly parking the literal `cellar automata` reading as a later side-check rather than a promoted branch.

items.description: Extend the literature snapshot with focused web and Semantic Scholar search rather than restarting from zero
items.acceptance_criteria: Update `results/literature/literature_snapshot.json` in place, preserve the existing entries, add at least 8 focused queries on Hadamard order 668, the cyclic 167/80 obstruction, modular order-668 constructions, CA combinatorial-design work, and direct competitor heuristics; log at least 10 directly relevant papers and at least 2 code or artifact repositories, or record an explicit none-found note.
items.notes: Updated `results/literature/literature_snapshot.json` in place with 11 focused query operations, 13 curated directly relevant papers, graph-traversal notes, and an explicit no-direct-repository note while preserving the original broad-query entries.

items.description: Create and maintain bibliography and prior-art gap records
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `sources.bib` in the repo root and keep it synchronized with consulted sources; include at least 10 relevant papers with BibTeX entries, including Constantine and Constantine 2025, Eliahou 2025, Bright-Kotsireas-Ganesh 2018, and the closest CA references; update `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` so every named watchlist paper has filled fields for overlap, differentiation hypothesis, evidence artifact, and pivot decision.
items.notes: Created `sources.bib` with 14 relevant entries, including the required Constantine, Eliahou, Bright, and CA anchors, and filled every watchlist entry in `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` with explicit overlap, differentiation, evidence, and pivot decisions.

items.description: Run Phase 1 multi-agent literature and concept exploration
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate `explorer`, `novelty_checker`, and `citation_auditor` to gather repo and literature evidence, then use `integrator` to synthesize; run concept exploration into `results/concept_evolve/tree/` so `index.json`, `adjacency.json`, and `walk_paths.json` exist with branches covering H1, H2, and at least one reserve concept.
items.notes: Completed the required multi-agent literature pass and recorded the synthesis in `results/analysis/phase1_multiagent_synthesis.md`; concept exploration artifacts exist in `results/concept_evolve/tree/index.json`, `adjacency.json`, and `walk_paths.json`, with explicit H1, H2, and reserve coverage.

items.description: Reconstruct the exact H1 target artifact and one solved same-template control
items.acceptance_criteria: Extract the exact length-167 weight-80 autocorrelation target from the current cyclic reduction and store it in a machine-readable artifact, plus one solved same-template positive control from a `4 x p` circulant or Goethals-Seidel instance; both artifacts must include provenance and exact verification commands.
items.notes: Created machine-readable exact artifacts for the unresolved `167/80` target in `results/artifacts/target_167_weight_80.json` and the solved `4 x 79` control in `results/artifacts/control_4x79.json`, each with provenance and deterministic verification commands from `python3 -m hadamard668.artifacts export`.

items.description: Define baseline data contracts and exact verifier interfaces
items.acceptance_criteria: Specify the on-disk schema for support sets, autocorrelation vectors, PSD checks, equivalence-class representatives, modular Gram defects, and run metadata; the verifier contract must state pass or fail criteria for exact hit, closest-target distance, modulus reached, defect count, and max defect magnitude.
items.notes: Wrote `results/analysis/verifier_contracts.md` and machine-readable schemas in `results/contracts/` covering support states, modular states, and run records, including exact-hit, closest-target, modulus-lift, defect-count, and max-defect pass criteria.

items.description: Lock matched baseline plans before trusting any CA branch
items.acceptance_criteria: Write a benchmark sheet for a symmetry-aware direct-search baseline on the same 167/80 support space and a same-seed non-CA local-search baseline for the 64-modular seed; each baseline must use the same representation, move budget, verifier, and equivalence accounting as the CA branch it controls.
items.notes: Locked the matched-budget plans in `results/analysis/baseline_benchmark_sheet.md`, including same-representation H1 and H2 baselines, shared neighborhoods, shared verifier contracts, shared orbit accounting, and the fairness repair that caps accepted moves per phase for both `parallel_gain_ca` and `direct_greedy`.

items.description: Pre-register kill rules, success metrics, and no-go gates
items.acceptance_criteria: Record explicit kill rules for H1, H2, and H3 before experiments: H1 dies if it loses to same-space direct search, H2 dies if it cannot lift solved controls or improve the 64-modular seed, H3 dies if compressed-state search adds no advantage; metrics must be exact-hit rate or closest-target rate for H1 and modulus lift or certificate-level improvement for H2.
items.notes: Recorded explicit branch kill rules and success metrics in `results/analysis/kill_rules.md` before the decisive reruns, with H1, H2, and H3 stop conditions tied directly to the matched baselines and verifier outputs.

items.description: Run Phase 2 multi-agent baseline review
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate `explorer` or `worker` for artifact extraction, `benchmark_auditor` for fairness review, `falsifier` for kill-rule review, and `integrator` for the final baseline packet; no Phase 3 implementation work starts until the auditors mark the baseline plan complete.
items.notes: Completed the required specialist review cycle and closed it with `results/analysis/phase2_baseline_review.md`. The fairness-corrected packet kills the current CA branch: H1 loses to matched direct search on both control and target, while H2 does not improve the real 668 seed over the same-neighborhood baseline.

items.description: Specify H1 Autocorrelation-Realization CA on the 167-cycle
items.acceptance_criteria: Write a design brief for H1 covering cell state, neighborhood, boundary conditions, seed family, invariants, orbit-slice extraction, reachability logging, and how CA outputs map back to the exact 167/80 target without collapsing into a circulant or Williamson restatement.

items.description: Specify H2 Defect-Transport CA as the conditional backup
items.acceptance_criteria: Write a separate design brief for H2 covering the 64-modular order-668 seed, defect-graph encoding, local update rules, conserved quantities, promotion condition, and the matched non-CA comparator; mark it dormant until H1 fails its first registered gate.

items.description: Refine reserve concepts through concept-tree iteration
items.acceptance_criteria: Use `.archivara/concept_evolve.py` `probe`, `reframe`, `iterate`, and `walk` to expand `results/concept_evolve/tree/` with reserve directions; keep at least 3 labeled branches alive, record why each is retained or retired, and ensure one branch explicitly tests whether a literal non-cellular `cellar automata` definition exists.

items.description: Run explicit novelty-collapse and prior-art differentiation audits
items.acceptance_criteria: For the active branch, write differentiation notes against `Cellular Automata Applications in Shortest Path Problem (2017)`, `Learning Automata-Based Solutions to the Single Elevator Problem (2019)`, `On the possibility of oscillating in the Ebola virus dynamics and investigating the effect of the lifetime of T lymphocytes (2022)`, and `Engineering Societies in the Agents World (2000)`, plus the relevant exact Hadamard papers; update `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` with evidence-backed pass or fail calls.

items.description: Run Phase 3 multi-agent hypothesis selection and synthesis
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate `research_director`, `hypothesis_scout`, `falsifier`, and `novelty_checker` to review H1, H2, and reserve branches, then use `integrator` to publish a single active-branch memo with dependencies, kill rules, and reasons for rejecting the alternatives.

items.description: Execute the H1 matched-budget control sweep before any broad search
items.acceptance_criteria: Run one modest CA rule and seed sweep on the solved positive control and then on the exact 167/80 target with matched-budget direct-search controls on the same support space; log exact-hit rate or closest-target distance, reachability coverage, equivalence collapse, and wall-clock cost.

items.description: Promote H2 only after H1 fails a registered gate
items.acceptance_criteria: If H1 fails cleanly, reconstruct the published 64-modular order-668 seed, run a smaller solved modulus-lift ladder, and only then spend one matched-budget 668 attempt; report modulus reached, defect count, and max defect magnitude against the same-seed non-CA baseline.

items.description: Audit reachability, fairness, and negative controls during experiments
items.acceptance_criteria: For every active branch, record at least one random-rule negative control, one intentionally weak baseline, and one equivalence-aware reachability audit; experiments are invalid if the CA gets a better seed, richer representation, or weaker verifier than its control.

items.description: Compare experimental outcomes against prior work and literature anchors
items.acceptance_criteria: Relate every result or failure mode back to the Phase 1 literature review by comparing against exact or structured search baselines, CA design-generation papers, and prior Hadamard heuristics; cite the relevant anchors from `sources.bib` and state whether the CA contributed search-space coverage, certificate rate, or only cosmetic reparameterization.

items.description: Run Phase 4 multi-agent experiment oversight and stop or go review
items.acceptance_criteria: Use `worker` to execute the active branch, `monitor` to track long runs and logs, `benchmark_auditor` and `falsifier` to audit interim results, and `integrator` to issue a stop or go memo after the first control sweep and after any H2 promotion.

items.description: Analyze outcomes, failure modes, and decision quality of the CA program
items.acceptance_criteria: Write an analysis memo that explains whether CA improved exact-hit rate, closest-target distance, modulus lifting, or reachability, and distinguish genuine progress from metric leakage or novelty collapse; include a clear stop, continue, or pivot recommendation.

items.description: Finalize literature, bibliography, and gap-maintenance artifacts
items.acceptance_criteria: Refresh `results/literature/literature_snapshot.json`, `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md`, and `sources.bib` so they match the executed branch and cited evidence; the final bibliography must cover every consulted source and no stale or unused entry may remain.

items.description: Produce specialist verification artifacts under results/verification
items.acceptance_criteria: Generate `results/verification/novelty_report.md`, `results/verification/citation_audit.md`, `results/verification/benchmark_report.md`, and `results/verification/verification_summary.md`; each file must contain a specialist verdict, supporting evidence, unresolved risks, and a pass or fail recommendation.

items.description: Package the research narrative and reproducibility record
items.acceptance_criteria: Prepare a concise methods and results packet describing the repo module map, selected branch, artifact provenance, experiment matrix, baselines, negative results, and reproduction commands; the packet must make it possible for a reviewer to rerun the active branch without ad hoc context.

items.description: Run Phase 5 multi-agent final synthesis and claim review
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate `citation_auditor`, `benchmark_auditor`, `novelty_checker`, and `integrator` for the final evidence gate; no claim survives unless it matches the evidence packet, passes citation and benchmark audits, and remains materially distinct from the named watchlist papers and exact Hadamard baselines, after which the writer and reviewer pipeline roles can sign off.
